title: Profit Maximum
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating why profit-maximizing price differs from revenue-maximizing price when production costs are considered. Shows overlaid revenue and profit curves with adjustable marginal cost.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Economics
Microeconomics
Profit Maximization
Pricing Strategy
Marginal Cost
Business Mathematics
learningObjectives: Distinguish total revenue from total profit by identifying the cost subtraction that separates the blue revenue parabola from the green profit curve
Explain why the profit-maximizing price exceeds the revenue-maximizing price whenever marginal cost is positive
Calculate the profit-maximizing price using P* = 100 + MC/2 and verify it against the green vertical line in the simulation
Predict how raising the Marginal Cost slider shifts the profit-max line to the right while the revenue-max line stays fixed at $100
Interpret the green profit rectangle and red loss rectangle on the demand curve as price moves above or below marginal cost
